neighbours.label: the '/bin' token in a Unix shebang or system path such as #!/usr/bin
fire: The first line of the file reads #!/usr/bin/python and must not be changed.

Here is the helper:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
echo done
Make it executable and start it with #!/usr/bin/perl on the first line.
Older systems used #!/bin/sh while newer ones prefer #!/usr/bin/env sh.
The cron entry calls /usr/bin/python3 /opt/jobs/backup.py every night.
